text:
jordan: heads up — deploybot failed the EU publish for service-payments. canary image got promoted in us but eu ECR rejected due to provenance digest mismatch :rotating_light:
ops-bot: deploybot: publish rejected: attestation_digest != manifest_digest (eu-ecr-prod, image: registry.redwood/service-payments:staging-2026-03-21)
maya: ugh. so staging canary in us runs fine, but eu registry has a different digest? any idea which stage produced the divergent metadata?
sam: quick check: the build id in metadata is the same, but cosign attestation timestamp differs (us: 2026-03-21T09:12Z, eu: 2026-03-21T09:14Z). suspects: mirror/retry wrote the image twice and a re-sign happened?
jordan: suspect mirror retry + KMS rotation caused newer attestation that doesn't match pinned manifest digest. deploybot treats that as provenance mismatch and blocks promote.
liam: can we fallback to the previous pinned digest in eu for now? we need to keep the release window; customers on eu will get stalled otherwise.
maya: two options: 1) retag the eu image to match the us digest (unsafe w/o verifying layers) 2) pin eu deploy to the last-known-good digest and skip the new publish (safer)
sam: i'd vote pin to last-known-good and open a rebuild-and-republish job. retagging will hide mismatch and could break reproducibility/audit.
jordan: agree. release-coordinator — does pinning cause any downstream rollout weirdness (release notes, change window)?
release-coordinator: pinning is fine for the immediate window, but we must note in release notes and schedule a replay publish to EU by EOD. also need a rollback criteria update: if eu canary fails after pin, we rollback globally.
liam: ok pin plan: set deploybot override to digest sha256:fa12b... (last-good) for eu region only, leave us on the new digest. canary will be checked for 30m then promote.
maya: I'll update release notes: "EU publish temporarily pinned to previous digest due to provenance mismatch; scheduled republish and audit."
jordan: who's owning the republish + audit?
sam: i'll take republish. steps: (1) rebuild image locally from build-id 20260321-0910 (2) force cosign sign with eu KMS key (3) push manifest and attestation to eu mirror and verify digest equals us digest.
liam: add a hold if republish fails: ops-bot can reapply hold tag to prevent auto-promotion. snippet to set pin:
```
# deploybot override
deploybot set-override --service service-payments --region eu-west-1 --digest sha256:fa12b... --reason "provenance mismatch"
```
ops-bot: acknowledged: override applied by liam at 6823456845
jordan: nice. maya pls add a short note in #release-notes and ping infra for the audit. sam, post status here when republish completes. if republish can't reconcile within 2 hours we rollback the whole release.
maya: added to release notes and pinged @eng-infra.
sam: republish started (building). will update in-thread.
ops-bot: deploybot: eu canary health check started for sha256:fa12b... (monitoring window 30m)
sam: republish done — pushed attestation, but verification still shows digest mismatch on eu mirror registry (looks like a layer upload lag).
liam: layer lag — can we force manifest re-reference after layers are present? or do we need to re-push layers?
sam: trying manifest re-push now. if that fails i'll re-upload layers with backpressure retry.
jordan: thanks team. temporary pin and release-note transparency is the priority. we'll reconvene if republish doesn't finish in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
